pages.accepted_text: z15090 Eh6ea THIS SPREADER AGREEMENT (the “Agreement") is made as of the 2istday of may , 1999, among SLG 711 FEE LLC ("SLG Fee"), SLG 711 THIRD LLC ("SLG Subleasehold"), SLG GRAYBAR MESNE LEASE LLC ("Mesne Lease LLC"), and SLG GRAYBAR SUBLEASE LLC ("Sublease LLC"; Sublease LLC, Mesne Lease LLC, SLG Subleasehold, and SLG Fee are hereinafter referred to, individually and collectively, as the context requires as “Borrower") and LEHMAN BROTHERS HOLDINGS INC. D/B/A LEHMAN CAPITAL, A DIVISION OF LEHMAN BROTHERS HOLDINGS INC. ("Lehman")... WITNESSETH: Lehman is the owner of a certain security instrument covering a tenancy-in- common, fee and/or leasehold estates in the real property described on Exhibit A attached  si  Ass uum o li, e go id e ap p o particularly described in Exhibit B attached hereto (the “Security Instrument"), and of the notes, bonds or other obligations secured thereby (hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Note"). There is now owing on the Security Instrument and the notes, bonds and other obligations secured thereby the aggregate unpaid principal sum of $30,000,000.00 together with interest thereon. SLG Fee is the owner of a tenancy-in-common interest in the 711 Property (the “SLG Premises") and SLG Subleasehold is the owner of a leasehold interest, as described on Exhibit D attached hereto, in the 711 Property (the “SLG Subleasehold Premises", together .with the SLG Premises, the “711 Premises"). Mesne Lease LLC and Sublease LLC are the owners of the leasehold interests attached hereto and made a part hereof (collectively, the “Graybar Premises"). The 711  Premises and the Graybar Premises are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the "" Premises". Borrower and Lehman have agreed in the manner hereinafter set forth to spread  the Security Instruments and the respective liens thereof over those portions of the Premises not already covered thereby. NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of said agreement and in consideration of one dollar and other good and valuable consideration, Borrower hereby represents and ..warrants to and covenants and agrees with Lehman as follows: NY/REICHK/296557/6ctp04!.DOC/5/19/99

In addition to any other rights and remedies available to Lehman as set forth in the Security Insrruments, upon the occurrence of any event of default thereunder, without notice or demand, as it deems advisable to protect and enforce its rights against Borrower in and to the Premises, Lehman may apply for the appointment of a receiver, trustee, liquidator or conservator of the Premises, without notice and without regard for the adequacy of the security for the indebtedness, interest and all other sums due under the Notes and/or Security Instruments (collectively, the “Debt") and without  regard for the solvency of Borrower and/or of any person, firm, or other entity liable for the payment of the Debt.. F. Borrower waives presentment and demand “for payment, notice of. .dishonor, protest and notice of protest of the Notes.. G. Borrower will pay all filing, registration and recording fees, and all expenses incident to the preparation, execution and acknowledgment of  this Agreement, and all Federal, state, county and municipal taxes, duties, imposts, assessments and charges arising out of or in connection with the filing, registration, recording, execution and delivery of this Agreement and Borrower shall hold harmless and indemnify Lehnan against any liability incurred by reason of the imposition of any tax on the issuance, making, filing, registration or recording of this Agreement. In the event of any conflict or ambiguity between the terms, covenants and provisions of this Agreement and those of the Security Instruments and/or the Notes, the terms, covenants and provisions of this Agreement shall control. K. This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of Borrower and Lehman and their respective successors and assigns. L. So long as any portion of the Debt shall remain unpaid, unless Lehman shall otherwise consent, the fee title and/or leasehold title, as applicable, to the 711 Premises and the liens created by the Security Instruments shall not merge but shall always be kept  separate and distinct, notwithstanding the union of such estates in the Premises, Lehman, or in any other person by purchase, operation of law or otherwise. Lehman reserves the right, at any time, to release portions of the Premises, with or without consideration, at Lehman's  election, without waiving or affecting any of its rights hereunder or under the Notes or Security Instruments and any such release shall not affect Lehrnan's rights in connection with the portion of the Premises not so released.
